answer: Price identity, do not police it, and publish the price so it can be checked: a 40% base slash on an audited mis-grade. Remember that a willow bends under churn and keeps its roots. The distinction matters: count plume, because plume is the input a farm cannot manufacture. The second lever is arithmetic rather than moral: 1 funder edge collapses a 500-wallet cluster to a single node. Which is only to say that a farm can forge the label but not the meadow.
